dedupe_keys.name: stellenbosch classroom indoor air quality and outage context 2023 2025

description: This dataset records indoor carbon dioxide, particles, temperature and humidity in Stellenbosch primary-school classrooms across six construction types. The research team compares container, prefabricated and brick rooms and documents how electricity outages affect mechanical ventilation. Current Mendeley version 11 covers February 2023–January 2025, with approximately 2.8 million observations at intervals that changed from eleven to three minutes. Seven CSV, JSON and Excel files include room properties, occupancy schedules, weather summaries, outage times and a codebook. Public access is free under CC BY-NC 3.0; commercial reuse is restricted. The describing article concerns version 6 and a shorter period. Packet losses, estimated timetable occupancy and the withholding of full weather data are documented limitations. A reviewer-assessed use is simulating ventilation loss, indoor heat or building performance during power interruptions. model-energyplus and model-nist-contam offer related building and airflow tools. No sensor data were downloaded or model fit evaluated.
name: Stellenbosch classroom indoor air quality and outage context, 2023–2025
